name: Editor Cut
blurb: His human editor's look (channel study 2026-10-24): opens on a real clip, 2-4 word glowing phrase captions with echo copies on key words, stamp / chart / money-rain graphics on his words, 3-4 cartoon FX transitions, a huge yellow word-by-word hero ending over his product footage.
